remarks: Luxurious and enchanting first floor 1 Bedroom, appr. 1500 Sq.Ft. - is located in a 2-unit building attached to an office building at/by the Merrit 7 train-stop. Superb commuter location. The grand entrance foyer features 9-foot coffered ceilings, stunning marble floors, and two spacious coat closets! The sophisticated open floor plan with an enormous kitchen/living and dining/ integrated - all in one - is truly first class, equipped with 2 TVs The walk-in pantry could be part of a home-office too. The extra large bedroom boasts of large walk-in closet and a second closet, and an additional 2nd TV. The grand bathroom, all marble, tile and granite has two sinks and a walk-in shower. The total Sq.Ft. in this unit is about 1500! 9' ceilings and custom moldings throughout. Separate fully equipped laundry room within the unit. The lobby entrance is shared with unit 2, both units have side entrances as well - and have interior access to the basement for private storage. See all details in the photos. 2 designated parking spaces per unit+. Most convenient location to all major highways, shopping, Cranbury Park etc. Also check Public Remarks (Addendum) for more details.
